Privacy &
enquiries.

How this website’s enquiry journey works.

Enquiry details

The enquiry form prepares a message using the name, company, service, location and project details you enter. The form does not submit these details to a website enquiry database.

Continue in WhatsApp

When you choose Continue in WhatsApp, your details are included in a link that opens WhatsApp. You can review the draft and choose whether to send it. Share only the information needed to discuss your project.

External services

WhatsApp and Google Maps links open external services. Their own privacy information applies when you use them. Email and telephone links open your device’s chosen applications.

Website delivery

The hosting provider processes technical requests needed to deliver the website. This website does not use advertising trackers or analytics scripts. The Contact page embeds Google Maps, which connects to Google when the map loads. Google’s privacy information applies to that service. Portfolio filters and photo controls operate in your browser.

Questions about your enquiry?

Contact Cyclonite Tech at cyclonitetech@gmail.com or +60 12 292 9224 to discuss information you have sent to the team.
